title: userspace proxy mode deprecated, removal in 1.25

detection.reason: read from the kube-proxy ConfigMap's own mode field; a mode passed only as a --proxy-mode container arg is not read here

quote: A deprecation notice has been added when using the kube-proxy userspace proxier, which will be removed in v1.25.
remediation: Move to `iptables` (or `ipvs`) on Linux, or `kernelspace` on Windows, before 1.25 — this mode is removed there, not merely warned about.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get cm -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | startswith("kube-proxy")) | (.data // {}) | to_entries[] | .value | scan("(?m)^ *mode: *\"?([a-z]+)") | .[0]'  # prints the configured kube-proxy mode; userspace is removed in 1.26
